title: Define the token boundary
hints: Separate byte values from special IDs.
Encode the string before adding sequence boundaries.
Empty text still has BOS and EOS.

title: Shift inputs and targets
hints: Identify the token each input position predicts.
The target window starts one position later.
A window needs context+1 available tokens.

title: Compute stable token loss
hints: Work with logits rather than rounded probabilities.
Subtract the selected logit from a stable log normalizer.
Average over every target position and keep the result differentiable.

title: Normalize residual activations
hints: Normalize magnitude without subtracting the mean.
Reduce squared values over the final dimension.
Epsilon belongs inside the square root; learned weights scale channels afterward.

title: Encode relative position by rotation
hints: Inspect a single adjacent coordinate pair.
Position times frequency gives its rotation angle.
Position zero is identity and each pair preserves squared norm.

title: Implement causal grouped-query attention
hints: Map a local query row to its absolute position.
Consecutive groups of query heads share one KV head.
Normalize scores over visible keys, never over query rows.

title: Build one decoder layer
hints: Draw the two residual branches separately.
Attention projection and SwiGLU return to model width.
The feed-forward gate and up projection multiply before the down projection.

title: Assemble a trainable decoder
hints: Trace one sequence through embeddings and every layer.
Register modules under the exact checkpoint names.
Return raw logits and post-rotation keys; keep the dense graph differentiable.

title: Implement AdamW
hints: Separate moment updates from parameter decay.
Bias correction depends on the incremented step count.
Decoupled decay acts on parameters, not on the raw gradient.

title: Schedule the learning rate
hints: Check the three endpoints before the interior.
Warmup reaches peak exactly at its boundary.
Clamp the cosine fraction after the total step count.

title: Clip a global gradient norm
hints: Treat all parameter gradients as one vector.
Compute one norm before changing any tensor.
Use one common scale factor; reject nonfinite norms before mutation.

title: Perform one token-weighted update
hints: Count the actual target tokens.
Accumulate loss sums, not equally weighted sequence means.
Zero gradients once, backpropagate the aggregate once, then step.

title: Save resumable state
hints: List what affects the next update besides weights.
Adam moments and CPU RNG state must be saved.
A resume checkpoint and an inference export have different consumers.

title: Resume without changing the trajectory
hints: Compare the next update, not just loaded values.
Restore optimizer hyperparameters as well as moments.
Restore RNG after constructing the replacement model.

title: Train and diagnose a tiny model
hints: Try memorizing one short sequence as a diagnostic.
Keep initialization inside a local random-state scope.
Reuse train_step so the tested update is the one used by the loop.

title: Export a portable model artifact
hints: Record the architecture and tokenizer with the weights.
Detach, clone and move exported tensors to CPU.
Hash the finished file bytes; export no optimizer state.
